npm test in server/ prints an uncaught workerd exception (broken.outputGateBroken) although all 37 tests pass.

rating.mostHelpful: The recipe should say what to answer for `server`, the one question with no default, when the person can't be asked, so a non-interactive build doesn't have to guess.
